title: Union Health Ministry Organises Two-Day National Conference of MDOs in collaboration with National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW) , Capacity Building Commission (CBC) and Karmayogi Bharat to Strengthen Organisational Capacity for Mission Karmayogi Implementation
body_text:
The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) organised a two-day National Conference of Ministry, Department and Organisations (MDOs) under the Department of Health and Family Welfare (DoHFW) on August 20–21, 2026, at the National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW), New Delhi. The conference was organised by the Training Division, DoHFW, in collaboration with NIHFW, Capacity Building Commission (CBC) and Karmayogi Bharat to strengthen organisational capacity for effective implementation of Mission Karmayogi.
The conference brought together representatives from 140 institutes under DoHFW, providing a platform for knowledge sharing, networking and collaboration to promote a ‘whole-of-government’ approach and break organisational silos. Dr. Alka Mittal, Member, CBC, as Chief Guest and Shri Rakesh Verma, Chief Operating Officer, Karmayogi Bharat, graced the inaugural session.
On the second day, Dr. Vinod Kotwal, Additional Secretary (Training), MoHFW, graced the event and emphasised the importance of capacity building and encouraged MDOs to contribute to Health Domain courses for caregivers, nursing and allied health professionals, geriatric care and other priority areas. She also urged MDOs to strengthen initiatives such as Capacity Building Units (CBUs) and finalisation of the Annual Capacity Building Plan (ACBP) 2026–27.
Top-performing MDOs were felicitated by Additional Secretary ma'am for their contribution during Sadhana Saptah, which helped DoHFW secure third rank in the 50,000+ employees category. The conference concluded with presentations on achievements, challenges and way forward, followed by distribution of certificates to participants.

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

enrichment.summary: The Union Health Ministry held a two-day National Conference of Ministry, Department and Organisations (MDOs) on 20-21 August 2026 at NIHFW, New Delhi, in collaboration with NIHFW, Capacity Building Commission and Karmayogi Bharat to strengthen capacity building for Mission Karmayogi implementation. Representatives from 140 DoHFW institutes discussed knowledge sharing, Capacity Building Units, the Annual Capacity Building Plan 2026-27, and felicitated top performers of Sadhana Saptah.
enrichment.context: Mission Karmayogi (National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building) was launched in 2020 to reform civil service training through competency-based capacity building, with Karmayogi Bharat as the implementing body and the Capacity Building Commission overseeing institutional capacity across ministries. Such conferences are routine administrative exercises meant to operationalise the mission at the departmental level rather than announce new policy.
